meta.name: autoskill
meta.description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析你的屏幕操作，自动发现重复研究流程并生成新技能。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常重复相似的研究操作，想把这些模式变成可复用的技能。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat similar research steps and want to turn them into reusable skills.

howto.what: 装上后,它会通过本地 screenpipe 读取你过去一段时间的屏幕记录,找出重复出现的工作模式,和已有的技能对比,为没覆盖到的模式起草新技能或组合现有技能的配方,并把草稿放进提案文件夹供你审阅。
howto.when: 当你明确请求 Claude 分析你最近几小时/几天的工作并提议新技能,或要求它从近期工作流找出未覆盖的模式时触发。需要本地运行 screenpipe 守护进程,否则拒绝执行。

say.text: 分析我过去一周的工作,提出新技能建议。
say.note: Claude 会扫描屏幕记录并生成技能提案。

say.text: 看看我最近的操作,有什么没被现有技能覆盖?
say.note: 它会对比现有技能并列出缺失的点。

say.text: 从这几天的屏幕记录里,帮我起草一个新技能。
say.note: 它会生成新技能草稿供你审阅。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads your recent screen activity from local screenpipe, detects repeated workflows, compares them with existing skills, and drafts new skills or composition recipes for uncovered patterns into a proposal folder.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly ask Claude to analyze your recent work and propose new skills, or find uncovered patterns. Requires local screenpipe daemon running.

say_en.text: Analyze my past week's work and suggest new skills.
say_en.note: Claude will scan screen logs and generate proposals.

say_en.text: Look at my recent activity and tell me what's not covered.
say_en.note: It compares against existing skills and lists gaps.

say_en.text: Draft a new skill from my screen recordings of the last few days.
say_en.note: It creates a skill draft for you to review.
